title: Server admin
subtitle: Manage who uses this server: users, organizations, limits and workers.
notAdmin: Only server admins can open this page. On the server, run bifrost-bench admin grant -email you@example.com, or add your email to HEIMDALL_SERVER_ADMINS and confirm it from the link we sent you.
localMode: The server admin page is for hosted servers. A local bench has one organization and no quotas.

overview.stubQuota: Limits are not saved: this server keeps them in memory, so edits are lost when it restarts. Turn on the Postgres limit store (shared workers) to keep them.

kill.title: Emergency stop
kill.on: On: no new runs start. Runs already going finish.
kill.confirmOn: Stop every organization from starting new runs? Runs in progress keep going.

users.empty: No users yet. The first sign-up creates the owner.
users.name: Name
users.confirmDisable: Disable {{email}}? They are signed out and can not sign in until enabled again.

orgs.empty: No organizations yet. Each sign-up creates one.
orgs.name: Name
orgs.quotaSummary: {{concurrent}} at once, {{perDay}} a day, ${{spend}} a day
orgs.runtimeRunscHint: Agents run under gVisor on the shared worker.
orgs.runtimeRuncHint: Agents share the host kernel. The shared worker serves this organization only when the operator set HEIMDALL_SHARED_ALLOW_RUNC; on a worker with gVisor they still run under gVisor.

quota.title: Limits for {{org}}
quota.allowCustom: Allow custom agent images (each needs approval)
quota.runcWarning: runc shares the host kernel. The shared worker serves runc organizations only when the operator sets HEIMDALL_SHARED_ALLOW_RUNC, and runs them under gVisor when the host has it.

images.empty: No image requests here. Organizations ask for one on their Workers page; approving it also lets that org run custom images.
images.unavailable: Image approval is not available on this server yet (shared workers are not turned on).

usage.unavailable: Platform usage is not available on this server yet.
usage.empty: No usage recorded in this period.
usage.orgError: Could not read this organization's runs: {{error}}

containers.empty: No workers registered. Hosted runs need the shared workers or a worker per organization.
containers.confirmRemove: Remove the record of worker {{runner}} from {{org}}? It is offline. If it still has a valid token it joins again when it starts.
